# Fund the Future 2026
> A real-deal fundraising arena for AI startups — learn from 20+ Vietnamese & international funds and experienced founders on 14.08, then fundraise live on the Conviction 2026 stage on 15.08.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://theedgealliance.com/): Fund the Future 2026 — AI Builders × Investors. Main event landing page with hero, countdown, organizers, partners, investors, roadmap, tickets, and FAQ.
- [Agenda](https://theedgealliance.com/agenda): Full event agenda for 14–15 August 2026 — Demo Day and Grand Finale schedule.

- [Sponsorship Proposal (EN)](https://theedgealliance.com/sponsor-en): Sponsorship proposal deck (English) — partnership opportunities for Fund the Future × Conviction 2026.

- [Judging Panel (EN)](https://theedgealliance.com/bgk-en): Judging Panel & Communities — judges and community page (English).

## Facts
- Event: Fund the Future 2026 / Sự kiện: Fund the Future 2026
- Slogan: AI Builders × Investors / AI Builders × Investors
- Demo Day: 14 August 2026 at SIHUB, 123 Truong Dinh Street, Ho Chi Minh City / Demo Day: 14 tháng 8 năm 2026 tại SIHUB, 123 Đường Trương Định, TP. Hồ Chí Minh
- Grand Finale: 15 August 2026 at THISO MALL SALA within Conviction 2026 / Chung kết: 15 tháng 8 năm 2026 tại THISO MALL SALA trong khuôn khổ Conviction 2026
- Organizers: Fresgen AI Co., Ltd. (Snappp.AI) & THE EDGE ALLIANCE / Ban tổ chức: Fresgen AI (Snappp.AI) & THE EDGE ALLIANCE
- 60+ startups registered / 60+ startup đã đăng ký
- 20+ Vietnamese & international investment funds / 20+ quỹ đầu tư Việt Nam & quốc tế
- $1M max fund ticket size per deal / Quy mô ticket tối đa $1M mỗi thương vụ
- Registration deadline: 11 August 2026 / Hạn chót đăng ký: 11 tháng 8 năm 2026
- Domain: theedgealliance.com / Tên miền: theedgealliance.com
- 4-step fundraising journey: Pitch deck advisory → Demo Day → Conviction finale → Post-program support / 4 bước gọi vốn: Tư vấn pitch deck → Demo Day → Chung kết Conviction → Hỗ trợ sau chương trình
- Audience tickets: Free ($0), Pro ($99), Platinum ($608) / Vé tham dự: Free ($0), Pro ($99), Platinum ($608)
- 10 VC funds confirmed (Aryon, Gen AI Fund, Eureka International, Do Ventures, The Asia Foundation, BLOCK71 Vietnam, Golden Gate Ventures, Lotte Ventures, Monk's Hill Ventures, VIC Partners)
- Main Partners: SIHUB — Saigon Innovation Hub, Conviction 2026
- Strategic Sponsors: Lotte Ventures, Nova Group
- Sponsors: Apify, Qwen AI, NVIDIA, AWS, JDI, NIC, Seedance, Haravan, ZAFAGO
- 20+ media partners including VTV Money
- Grand Finale held within Conviction 2026: 150+ speakers, 26K+ registrations, 100+ exhibitors, 65M impressions / Chung kết trong khuôn khổ Conviction 2026: 150+ diễn giả, 26K+ lượt đăng ký, 100+ đơn vị triển lãm, 65M lượt hiển thị
- Startup benefits: guaranteed Demo Day slot, 1-on-1 advisory, direct fund connections, Grand Finale shot, media coverage & DD support
- Legal: Operated by Fresgen AI Co., Ltd. under The Edge Alliance brand. Organizers never receive or hold any investment money. / Vận hành bởi Công ty TNHH Fresgen AI dưới thương hiệu The Edge Alliance. BTC không tiếp nhận hay nắm giữ bất kỳ khoản tiền đầu tư nào.
